authorization: Standing user auto-approval for remaining inspected mapping decisions; log limitations for review.
decisions: Older US delivered gas is replaced on its explicit MJ output basis by the IAM high-pressure delivered-gas proxy using 1/36 m3 per MJ. Its pressure and original energy-value metadata are unspecified; retain unquantified pressure/network, geography and vintage differences.

Legacy xxx diesel storage outputs are 1 kg diesel. Forward them to the IAM diesel mix using the reviewed modern native delivery auxiliaries; legacy refining/grade, allocation, distribution and vintage differences remain unquantified screening proxies.
Do not forward producer-specific refinery outputs or explicitly fossil-only storage through a fuel blend. Those retain their own commodity boundaries.

Rebuild historical fuel constituents using IAM shares; preserve native ancillary services by declared input identity, including kg-based water and waste services that a unit-only filter would incorrectly drop.
Directly specified upstream production, venting/flaring and production-route consumption are outside delivered-market handovers; do not substitute a different product boundary.
The separate native vehicle Fuel supply blends and combustion-carbon reclassification remain unfinished checks before public fuel support.
